text: No Reception report for 18 Nov was seen, so there is no occupancy figure for the day; the last reported figure is 93 of 183 rooms (50.8%) on 16 Nov, 44 of them Rabdan. Accounts reported that a Rabdan group occupying 19 one-bedroom units plans to check out this week or next, and Operations said the rent increase on all room types is affecting occupancy and renewals.

Reports for 18 Nov received from Operations, Maintenance, IT, Accounts, the Flower shop and AJ1881. Reception, Housekeeping and Drivers reports were not seen. On 19 Nov the CEO instructed IT and Maintenance to attach photos of completed work to every daily report.

Operations again reported ADNOC’s requirements approved for the 50 premium-room offer; ADNOC’s team sent the checklist to its HSE Compliance head for endorsement, while Risk Management and the Emergency Response Plan are still listed for completion. Operations sent the Ras Al Khaimah client the proposal and check-in requirements for 15 premium rooms, contacted an engineering company about an accommodation offer, and hosted an agent site visit for a 2-bedroom unit (check-in mid-December).

AJ1881 sales were AED 142 from 7 covers, all beverages. AJ1881 again asked for approval of a petty-cash purchase for out-of-stock kitchen items and to rename the shop to Oui Cafe. The flower shop recorded no sales, posted new social media content and is looking for a chiller van.

Maintenance completed 6 jobs on 18 Nov, including ground-floor ceiling painting, basement service-lift lobby painting, fused lights in basements 1–4 and the room 1207 hot water fix. Still pending: room 706 thermostat, room 710 FCU rewinding (awaiting approval), the rooftop calorifier leak and basement parking lights. IT fixed 2 complaints (room 1110 card, room 501 Wi-Fi); the control room PC is locked after a power trip.

Operations again forwarded the elevator AMC renewal to Madam for urgent approval and told the facility management company to arrange a third-party provider for the general inspection. It also asked them for one more housekeeping staff member (10am–7pm). Etisalat declined the new high-speed connection because a line is already active; IT needs a decision between disconnecting the current line (about a week offline) or the Digital Internet plan (1–2 days after UAE Pass confirmation).

Accounts reported no money received and no overdue rent on 18 Nov, one cheque deposited or returned for room 809 (not stated which), and two more invoices submitted to Rabdan Academy. The Etisalat bill is still awaiting approval.

Awaiting decision: elevator AMC renewal, the facility management AMC proposal (BMS, lift, Tamouh), room 710 FCU rewinding, the Etisalat connection option and bill, the lobby partition concern, the MBG accounting and VAT proposal, the AJ1881 rename and kitchen purchase, and pending offer letters and visa processing.
